shared_or_similar_visual_information: Equivalent layouts for one real number: π/4 and (1/4)π.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The label gives the marked angle's measure in radians at the origin. Right image: The label gives the marked point's x-coordinate on the function graph.
Rationales: π/4=(1/4)π, but one is an angle measure and the other an x-coordinate; numerical equivalence does not establish the same local mathematical role.
